propositions: Ticking AC checkboxes does not invalidate plan-review attestations because checkbox state is normalized out of the material fingerprint basis before hashing.
Staleness messages incorrectly name a fixed list (description/AC/file_impact/children) instead of reporting which component actually changed, hiding the true cause.
Per-component fingerprints must be recorded in the signed manifest as additive material-part: lines because the composite hash is one-way and children is derived from other tickets at read time.
A pre-330c attestation over an unchanged ticket returns stale-material despite no actual edit because it hashed raw description while normalized recompute cannot match.
All attestation refusal surfaces must be swept to consistently name changed components in reasons rather than fixed lists or omitting the cause entirely.
No gate outcome changes: the fix is diagnostic-only, adding reason details and additive manifest lines while keeping verdict values and branch conditions unchanged.
